name: – § 1, after point d – Am 3
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the European Democracy Shield, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
part_text: (db) to pay special attention to the disproportionately harmful effects of far-right ideas and conspiracy theories promoted by malicious third-country actors on those groups in society already affected by exploitation and discrimination, such as women, the LGBTQ+ community, refugees and migrant communities, low-income households, ethnic minorities and people living with disabilities;
